description: This Java source file defines a final class `ThingsConditionalHeadersValidatorProvider` which provides a singleton instance of `ConditionalHeadersValidator` for validating conditional (HTTP) headers on 'Thing' resources, with specialized settings and logic to skip checks based on certain fields like `_policy`.
